description: Runtime constants for the Member 2 inference stack. Module A's layer weights and PASS/MONITOR/HOLD/REJECT thresholds are NOT here — they live inside the fitted PipelineConfig in anomaly_pipeline.joblib. This file holds what the notebooks tune outside an artifact.

module_a.training_split: component_split.csv -> split == train (batch-grouped, no lot crosses train/val/test)
module_a.explanation: multivariate layer = one IsolationForest per Part_Type plus a global fallback when a group has < 30 rows
module_a.shap_source: anomaly_shap_bundle.joblib (portable plain dict: per-group IsolationForests, background samples, imputation medians)

module_b.models: tuned RandomForest + MultiOutput GradientBoosting fused by a Ridge meta-learner, with GradientBoosting quantile regressors (alpha 0.05 / 0.95) for the interval
module_b.quantile_crossing: lower/upper swapped where the intervals crossed before reconstruction
module_b.safety_slope_source: 99th percentile of |drift rate| (units/hour) measured on Safe TRAIN rows only; used for the early-rejection flag

module_c.tuning_note: Weights found by a 500-draw Dirichlet search on the val split targeting >= 98% recall on val Fail cases; risk_safe_max = min(80th pct of val Safe scores, borderline cut - 0.1); risk_borderline_max = max(95th pct of val Safe scores, 98%-recall threshold). Retune in reliability_index.ipynb and update this block - no code change needed.

explainability.tuning_note: SHAP is off by default because the anomaly explainer is a PermutationExplainer (~1.3 s/row). Flip `enabled` to true, or run `python -m database ingest <csv> --explain 50`, to attribute flagged components only.
